items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames. Using only the best aluminum available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics created a WZRD frame optimized for flatland skating, also known as Wizard skating. The perfect Wizard Skating Setup. The WZRD F frame is unique in every way. These Wizard Skating Frames feature a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame optimally by placing smaller wheels in front and larger wheels in back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. Originally designed in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it creates a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames uses a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe- or heel-based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames, with Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminum (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel. Not just a copycat, based on Symetrics values. Simply designed for ultimate Wizard Skating performance.
